fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5% of Gross Sales, paid weekly. A Minimum Royalty Fee applies starting in the 7th month if the franchisee fails to meet the Minimum Monthly Average Sales Quota; the minimum royalty is the difference between 5% of actual Gross Sales and 5% of the applicable Sales Quota (varies by territory size and year of operation — e.g., Year 1: $10,000/mo for territories with 20k+ seniors, $5,000/mo for smaller territories). Marketing Fund Contribution is 2% of Gross Sales, paid weekly; a Minimum Marketing Fund Contribution applies on the same trigger and structure. Minimum Local Advertising Requirement is the greater of $300 or 2% of Gross Sales per month (payable to third parties). Systems Fee is $100/week (~$433/month) paid to franchisor, beginning 4 months after Effective Date — covers technology/dashboard/extranet access; may increase up to 50%/year with 60 days notice. Satellite Systems Fee is $13/week if franchisee opens a second Satellite Office. Software Scheduling Fees are tiered by active clients: <22 clients = $200/mo; 23–100 = $9.00/client/mo; 101–200 = $8.50/client/mo; 201–300 = $8.00/client/mo; 301–400 = $7.50/client/mo; >400 = $7.00/client/mo. Additional fees include: Advertising Service Fee ($250/mo current, collected only if Minimum Local Advertising Requirement not met), Transfer Fee (50% of then-current IFF), Expansion Fee (80% of then-current IFF), Audit Expenses (if understatement ≥3%), Late Fees (highest rate allowed by law), Background Check Fees ($25–$75/caregiver), Ongoing Training Non-Attendance Fee ($1,500), AFM fee ($750/person), AFM Non-Attendance Fee ($2,000), Additional E-Mail Fees ($252/year per address beyond 4), Legal and Compliance Toolkit Fee ($1,000). tech_fee_monthly is estimated as $100/week × 52/12 ≈ $433.
